direction.description: Layout direction for the group: 'horizontal' (default, items in a row) or 'vertical' (items stacked). Changing this updates the direction of all child pivot items.

selectedValue.description: The value of the currently selected pivot item. Set this to control selection programmatically, or listen for the change event to react to user selection. Defaults to empty string (no selection).

allowDeselect.description: If true, allows the user to deselect the currently selected item by clicking it again (resulting in no selection). If false (default), one item is always selected unless selectedValue is empty. Available when...

items.description: The pivots of the group, one `obc-pivot-item` for each (a pivot's icon is an `obi-` child in the slot `icon`), as a list with one object for each: `tag` and then the element's attributes by name, `text`, `id` (reported by the element's events), `slot` and `children` (objects of the same form). Tags and attributes: `obc-pivot-item` (value, selected, direction, hasLeadingIcon, hasLabel, label, disabled).

componentSize.description: Component size: regular, medium, large or xl.
